claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows devices heavily wrapped in masking and electrical tape.
The internal battery condition cannot be seen through the tape and casing.
Battery discharge rate requires physical testing over time.
Photo 0 shows heavy taping which typically indicates the casing has been opened or is structurally compromised.

risks.risk: Fire hazard or swollen cells hidden under tape.
risks.proof: A video of the devices with all tape removed showing the original casing integrity.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification label usually found on the back or side.
Video showing each port successfully charging a mobile device.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the devices with all tape removed.
Close-up photo of the printed specifications (mAh, Model, Brand).
Video showing the devices charging and being charged.
response.reason: The witness has identified the items as power banks, and the seller admits they are scrap. They can be priced at the lowest possible value for parts or scrap metal/cells.
